_comment: Text pools for the paired-perturbation audit. Revisions are pinned commit SHAs. 'contamination' records which guards are known or likely to have trained on the source (see paper1/SPEC.md section 3).

gandalf.contamination: Unknown for commercial/vendor guards; not in GuardShield training.

deepset_test.contamination: deepset/fmops trained on deepset train split; GuardShield trained on deepset data; ProtectAI v2 training mix unknown. Report as in-distribution for those guards.

dolly.contamination: Generic instruction data; may appear as benign training data for some guards.

notinject.contamination: PIGuard was designed against NotInject (its own benchmark); treat PIGuard results on it as favourable.

guardshield_test.contamination: In-distribution for GuardShield (home advantage). Use only for the GuardShield-specific analysis.
